name: cm_native_blender_convention

Unit-carrier correction measured 2026-10-07 on disposable synthetic copies: canonical metre coordinates become centimetre coordinates on independent export data; effective global_scale cancels the writer scene-unit factor. Raw Null scale1/UnitScaleFactor1, dimensions/weights/frames preserved; temporary Blender readback decodes only the pinned importer unit carrier after independent raw Null/bone scale admission, without mutating imported geometry or rest data. This does not establish physical native Unreal bind parity. Verified UE5.8 legacy GetRootSkeleton predicate (2026-10-08) skips a top-level Null named Armature for a Blender creator. Only the disposable export object receives this name; collisions refuse without renaming originals. Actual native hierarchy confirmation remains required.
